name: Times 1.5, 2.5, and 0.5
rule: × 0.5 is half. × 1.5 is the number plus half of it. × 2.5 is double plus half.
why: 1.5 is 1 and a half, so you take one copy of the number and half of another copy. Same for 2.5: two copies and a half.
workbookSection: Unit 2: Lessons 2.4 and 2.8 (y = kx and scale)
